title: NV centre spin in a 13C bath

checks.name: Hahn-echo T2 at 1.1% 13C
checks.note: median over 16 random baths; spread 0.73-1.01 ms

checks.name: Hahn-echo T2 at 0.3% 13C
checks.note: median over 16 random baths; spread 2.81-3.77 ms

notes: The record is not carried away by any particle; it is written into the bath's own flip-flops. The domain is the electron plus the nuclei within a few nm, and T2 is how long their records stay alike. The model has no fitted parameter. It counts only 13C pairs; real crystals also hold nitrogen and other electron spins, which can only shorten T2, and at 0.3% 13C those other spins are likely to dominate. A single NV's T2 also varies with its own bath: the computed 16-84% spread is reported with each value.
